race.comment: ATSUI HARU (11) was just fair on debut but improved nicely to miss by 0.8L when at 1400m at Bunbury last time out. Tsang's claim means she'll carry no weight and she maps perfectly out to the mile for the first time. Looks primed to pick up her maiden victory. HISTORY SUPREME (5) bolted in to win  trial prior to his debut where he closed nicely from back in the field, finishing 1.8L off the winner. He'll be better for that effort and may be able to sit closer now with a good draw and the race experience. Can make his presence felt. TRICKSTER (9) dipped his toe in the water of higher company two back before a 3.5L defeat at Bunbury in an improved effort most recently. Pike opts to ride him over ATSUI HARU, so that's a good push for his chances. On the quick turnaround and can feature in the finish. SYLVA JACK (1) won't be far away if he brings his best form. FOREVER VICTORIOUS (8) can improve with the fresh run behind her and CJP on board.
